claim_scope: Train-only block-32 architecture pilot from the latest persisted parent checkpoint. Validation and test_id remain sealed.
hypothesis: A bounded parent-anchored block-32 residual corrector with two-frame residual history will improve exact full-401 group-disjoint train-confirmation future relative L2 by at least 5% over the immutable epoch-24/step-350/update-16450 pyramid parent, with no family regression.
expected_mechanism: Joint 32-frame prediction learns local phase/amplitude closure; a detached pushforward block exposes generated-state inputs; every block is re-anchored to the frozen frequency-parent trajectory.

data.truth_access: Exact float32 train wavefield slices only during offline optimization and post-prediction train metrics.

training.selection_metric: 34-record train-calibration exact full-401 future relative L2

acceptance.primary_metric: 34-record group-disjoint train-confirmation exact full-401 future relative L2
acceptance.runtime_gate: Reject before validation if measured parent plus corrector runtime cannot plausibly preserve 10x end-to-end speedup.

failure_signal: Stop on hash drift, cross-role group overlap, split mismatch, non-finite loss or gradient, correction-cap violation, OOM, missing checkpoint, less than 5% confirmation gain, family regression, or any validation/test_id access.

supersedes_failed_smoke.failure: The v1 loader incorrectly rejected multiple source records from one group even when all belonged to the same role.
supersedes_failed_smoke.fix: Permit same-role multi-source records and reject only groups crossing fit/calibration/confirmation roles.

rollback: Preserve the parent and all prior artifacts; omit the additive corrector if this candidate fails.
